decisions.DEC-NATIVE-UPDATE-001: User-approved native update integration: one package identity, three architecture channels, trusted configured GitHub Release feeds, SDK payload verification, explicit download/apply, atomic cross-process mutation admission; no startup auto-apply or model/settings migration.

experiments.EXP-NATIVE-UPDATE-001: Runtime boundary tests are not installed V1-to-V2 release acceptance. Each platform requires separate real installed update, restart, corruption, and retained-state verification before publication.
